name: minimal_test_bootstrap
description: Structure minimale pour bootstrapper les tests : 1 test trivial (import), 1 test métier simple. Valide l'exécutabilité avant d'ajouter de la complexité.
code:
# tests/test_summarize.py
import pytest
from summarize import summarize

def test_import_works():
    """Validate that the module imports and is callable."""
    assert callable(summarize)

def test_simple_case():
    """Test with minimal input."""
    result = summarize('hello world')
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert len(result) > 0
